analysis: Jain et al. GNP100 apparent distance-decay uncertainty analysis
fit: Unweighted ordinary least squares of ln(r_d) = intercept - alpha * length

sampling.independence: Published length and rate uncertainties sampled independently
sampling.distributions: Gaussian using published means and SD values
sampling.truncation: Non-positive or non-finite sampled lengths and rates rejected and resampled

interpretation: This propagates published summary uncertainties. It is not a stochastic electron-transfer simulation and does not validate a microscopic mechanism.
